title: Naturality of normalized rational evaluation
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, and $W$ a scheme on whose residue fields $\ell$ is invertible. Use the raw rational category and operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the normalized partial closed structure of [lem-pod-derived-automorphism-hom-evaluation]. For permitted rational Hom pairs $P=(A,B)$ and $P\prime=(A\prime,B\prime)$ and any pair morphism $g=(a^{op},b):P\to P\prime$, where $a:A\prime\to A$ and $b:B\to B\prime$, write $H$ for internal Hom, $T$ for tensor, and $ev_P:T(H(P),A)\to B$ for Hom-first evaluation. Then $ev_{P\prime}\circ T(H(g),1_{A\prime})=b\circ ev_P\circ T(1_{H(P)},a)$. This holds for arbitrary localized arrows, including sums.

source.place: Proof paragraph 2; rational extension of the completed evaluation naturality in lem-pod-derived-automorphism-hom-evaluation, step 14.

proof.text: Normalize rational tensor, internal Hom and evaluation by their defining integral object equalities. On pure localized tensors the equation is the integral evaluation naturality equation multiplied by the product of coefficients. Tensor-product induction in both arrows extends it to arbitrary rational morphisms.
